subject: english
prompt: Choose the sentence that keeps the contrast in 'Although the bus was late, Mia arrived on time.'（英語學習內容 A：用句型線索完成準確溝通）

options.text: A Mia arrived on time even though the bus was late.（本課判讀焦點：字彙、句型、時態、連接與語意功能）
B Mia missed the bus before it was late.（本課判讀焦點：字彙、句型、時態、連接與語意功能）
C The bus arrived because Mia was early.（本課判讀焦點：字彙、句型、時態、連接與語意功能）
D Mia made the bus late.（本課判讀焦點：字彙、句型、時態、連接與語意功能）

answer.explanation: Although and even though both introduce a contrast: the bus was late, but Mia arrived on time.。 本題的直接證據是題幹「Choose the sentence that keeps the contrast in 'Although the bus was late, Mia arrived on time.'（英語學習內容 A：用句型線索完成準確溝通）」所給的條件；將它與選項 A 對照即可完成最後核對（lesson-english-content-root-a）。正確答案為選項 A：「A Mia arrived on time even though the bus was late.（本課判讀焦點：字彙、句型、時態、連接與語意功能）」。最後把這個選項放回題幹，確認它同時符合題目條件與本單元判準。
